glosses: A raised platform in a church, sometimes enclosed, where the minister or preacher stands when giving the sermon; also, the lectern on such a platform.

examples.text: Always, whether in the pulpit or on the platform, as in private conversation, there is an absolute simplicity about the man and his words; a simplicity, an earnestness, a complete honesty.
[H]is `Amens' were ejected at the pulpit with the severity of a reprimand.

glosses: Activity associated with or usually performed from a church pulpit; preaching, sermons, religious teaching.
The preaching profession, office, or role in general; the pastorate, the priesthood, the ministry.
Preachers collectively; clergy; the priesthood.
An individual or particular preaching position or role; a pastorate.

examples.text: He seems like too timid a man to fill the pulpit at such a large church.

glosses: Bully pulpit.

A bow platform for harpooning.

examples.text: Oui, c’était son devoir de les avertir ; il fallait qu’il le fît, qu’il le fît avec force, qu’il le fît avec éclat, qu’il le clamât en pleine chaire, un beau dimanche, car cela devenait scandaleux à la fin !

examples.text: Le clergé partage l’opinion de la noblesse, et a de plus que lui l’influence de la chaire et du confessionnal.

glosses: Ensemble des prédicateurs.

examples.text: Nous sommes arrivés, de critique en critique, à cette triste conclusion : […] ; que tous ces mots Droit, Devoir, Morale, Vertu, etc., dont la chaire et l'école font tant de bruit, ne servent à couvrir que de pures hypothèses, de vaines utopies, d'indémontrables préjugés; […].
